limitations: Full roster target not met; cold and concurrent delays remain.
courseMetadata timing is a sum of helper durations that may nest/overlap, not wall time or a SQL statement count.
TTFB minus handler and proxy timings still includes transport and framework overhead, not a measured network-only span.
Independent favicon control request is not the same route as the roster and is not used to attribute improvement.
Four synthetic cohorts have one or two learners; no formal Silverlily, physical iPad, Safari or Taiwan-local network acceptance.
Only Preview branch tuning is enabled; unchanged URL/default behavior when the override is absent.
Per-client limit of two can exceed two total connections when several clients coexist; no server-wide setting changed.
No booking, attendance, payment, refund or debit submitted; current task read the already-expanded November/December calendar. Counts are not a full row-level financial audit.
